cues.text: The Moonlight Bridge, after the battle. You and the others stand in a row on the empty roadway, looking up toward the bridge's far tower, Koromaru among you. Then everyone turns and gathers in a loose circle around you.
Junpei slumps and wails. Yukari nods, smiling, and Fuuka, Akihiko and Ken laugh.
You turn away from the circle. The whole team stands side by side, looking out along the bridge toward its tower.
